basic_info.description: Situated just 2 blocks from the Embarcadero waterfront & Ferry Building, savor city living at its finest in this masterpiece by the globally acclaimed firm Arquitectonica.  This 2Bd/2Ba homes features beautifully refinished Brazilian IPE engineered wood floors and offers luxury living w/in the boutique mid-rise of the renown Infinity Building with quick access to the Club Lounge & Theater for effortless entertaining. Serene view of a colorful roof garden from the Living Room & primary bedroom. The latter is large enough for an office space and seating area, and the 2nd bedroom overlooks a green courtyard. Both closets are outfitted with dark wood organizers.   The Kitchen boasts Studio Becker cabinetry and Bosch & Thermador appliances. Updated with stunning light fixtures and black cabinet pulls, this home is great for entertaining and yet a tranquil retreat.   333 Main has only 9 floors which gives it the feeling of a boutique building, and yet it is the closest out of 4 buildings, to the property's world-class amenities: 5,000-sq.ft. Fitness Center, 75-ft Pool, Sauna, Lounge, Theater and Business Center, a full-time Concierge and Reception.    Only a block to Saint Frank Coffee, Philz, and Sweet Green! Easy access to public transport, Hwy 101 & 280.
